code-reviewer.name: code-reviewer
code-reviewer.description: Reviews a change through exactly one review lens (L1–L5) and reports prioritised findings; read-only. Use when a caller fans out a pre-PR review, one code-reviewer per lens (a full review is five dispatches, per meaningfy-code-review). Not for fixing code (implementer) or discussing findings.

conceptual-modeller.name: conceptual-modeller
conceptual-modeller.description: Builds and evolves a domain's conceptual model with the user, model-driven and data-centric, choosing the model source and rendering. Use when modelling a domain or evolving an ontology. Not for delegation; not for system architecture (system-architect).

devops-engineer.name: devops-engineer
devops-engineer.description: Operates Meaningfy's infrastructure with a person who is not a devops engineer: reads both infra repositories and monitoring, plans each change, gets it reviewed, asks consent with a plain-words card, applies exactly what was shown, verifies and records it. Use when someone opens a session in the stacks repository to change, deploy, fix, resize or retire a server or stack. Not for delegation; not for the unattended watch (ops-watch) or a read-only review (infra-reviewer).

epic-planner.name: epic-planner
epic-planner.description: Shapes an EPIC from human seeds and derives its clarity-gated PLAN (≥9/10) as an OpenSpec change, returning question rounds to the caller until no decision is open. Use when starting or refining an epic. Not for archiving or grooming living specs (spec-stewardship) or for writing code (implementer).

implementer.name: implementer
implementer.description: Implements one ready task of an OpenSpec change as tested production code, test-first. Use when a task in tasks.md is ready (PLAN gated ≥9/10, Gherkin written). Not for planning (epic-planner), reviewing (code-reviewer) or committing.

infra-reviewer.name: infra-reviewer
infra-reviewer.description: Reviews one infrastructure change — an OpenSpec change's plan or a PR in either infra repository — against the devops skills and reports findings, blast radius, undo path and stack conformance; read-only. Use when a caller wants the four-eyes review before executing a plan, mid-implementation or before merging. Not for applying or fixing changes (devops-engineer).

ops-watch.name: ops-watch
ops-watch.description: Watches Meaningfy's infrastructure with no human present: runs the daily check-up, answers alerts with allow-listed operations only when the unattended-action policy says act, parks everything else with a decision card, and reports every run to Slack and GitHub issues. Use when the schedule or an alert fires, or when the owner starts a check-up by hand. Not for delegation; not for planned changes (devops-engineer).

proposal-writer.name: proposal-writer
proposal-writer.description: Writes a sendable proposal or offer email from client requirements, asking the questions it needs through its output, with estimate and executive framing. Use when a client asks for an offer. Not for pricing strategy alone (estimation).

sales-agent.name: sales-agent
sales-agent.description: Keeps Meaningfy's Odoo sales pipelines true and moving: grooms deals and contacts with logged, reversible writes, prepares meetings and drafts, and asks the owner only through decision cards. Use when the scheduled open-day, close-day and weekly runs fire, or when the owner opens a sales working or intake session. Not for delegation.

system-architect.name: system-architect
system-architect.description: Designs a new system with the user before code: use cases, architectural decisions and system diagrams, stating its view and plan briefly before each step. Use when starting or reshaping a system's architecture. Not for delegation; not for code (implementer).
